mapper.sql: u.user_id AS "id",u.lgn_id AS "loginId",u.user_nm AS "name",u.email_addr AS "email",u.tel_no AS "phone", u.bsn_part_id AS "basePartId",u.dev_id AS "developerId",u.user_stts_cd AS "status",u.last_lgn_at AS "lastLoginAt",u.rsgn_dt AS "resignDate", (u.mfa_yn='Y' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.admin_yn='Y' AND r.use_yn='Y')) AS "mfaRequired"

where.if: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_part p WHERE p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.bsn_part_id=#{partId})
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role r WHERE r.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id=#{roleId})

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.user_info u ORDER BY u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM sys.user_info u WHERE u.user_id=#{id}
SELECT role_id FROM sys.user_role WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY role_id
SELECT bsn_part_id FROM sys.user_part WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY bsn_part_id
SELECT prj_id FROM sys.user_prj WHERE user_id=#{id} ORDER BY prj_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.user_info SET user_stts_cd='ACTIVE',lock_at=NULL,lgn_fail_cnt=0,otp_fail_cnt=0 WHERE user_id=#{id} AND user_stts_cd='LOCKED' AND (rsgn_dt IS NULL OR rsgn_dt > (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date)
mapper.sql: role_id AS "id",role_nm AS "name",role_desc AS "description",data_scope_cd AS "dataScope",use_yn AS "useYn", snstv_inq_yn='Y' AS "sensitiveView",part_std_chg_auth_yn='Y' AS "partStandardChange",admin_yn='Y' AS "admin",bltin_yn='Y' AS "builtIn"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.role ORDER BY sort_seq,role_id

INSERT INTO sys.role(role_nm,role_desc,data_scope_cd,use_yn,snstv_inq_yn,part_std_chg_auth_yn,admin_yn,copy_role_id,created_by) VALUES(#{name},#{description},#{dataScope},#{useYn},CASE WHEN #{sensitiveView} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{partStandardChange} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CASE WHEN #{admin} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{copyRoleId},#{actor}) RETURNING role_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.role SET role_nm=#{name},role_desc=#{description},data_scope_cd=#{dataScope},use_yn=#{useYn},snstv_inq_yn=CASE WHEN #{sensitiveView} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,part_std_chg_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{partStandardChange} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,admin_yn=CASE WHEN #{admin} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_id=#{id}

UPDATE sys.role_menu_auth a SET inq_auth_yn=b.inq_auth_yn,reg_auth_yn=b.reg_auth_yn,mdfcn_auth_yn=b.mdfcn_auth_yn,del_auth_yn=b.del_auth_yn,upld_auth_yn=b.upld_auth_yn,dwnld_auth_yn=b.dwnld_auth_yn,cnfrm_auth_yn=b.cnfrm_auth_yn FROM sys.role_menu_auth b WHERE a.role_id=#{id} AND b.role_id=#{sourceId} AND a.menu_id=b.menu_id
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS "menuId",m.menu_nm AS "name",m.scrn_id AS "screenId",m.upr_menu_id AS "parentId", COALESCE(a.inq_auth_yn='Y',false) AS "inq",COALESCE(a.reg_auth_yn='Y',false) AS "reg",COALESCE(a.mdfcn_auth_yn='Y',false) AS "mdfcn",COALESCE(a.del_auth_yn='Y',false) AS "del",COALESCE(a.upld_auth_yn='Y',false) AS "upld",COALESCE(a.dwnld_auth_yn='Y',false) AS "dwnld",COALESCE(a.cnfrm_auth_yn='Y',false) AS "cnfrm" FROM sys.menu m LEFT JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.menu_id=m.menu_id AND a.role_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.sort_seq,m.menu_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.role_menu_auth SET inq_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{inq} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,reg_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{reg} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,mdfcn_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{mdfcn} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,del_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{del} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,upld_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{upld} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,dwnld_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{dwnld} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,cnfrm_auth_yn=CASE WHEN #{cnfrm} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_id=#{id} AND menu_id=#{menuId}
mapper.sql: menu_id AS "id",menu_nm AS "name",scrn_id AS "screenId",upr_menu_id AS "parentId",icon_nm AS "icon",sort_seq AS "sortOrder",use_yn AS "useYn",mbl_expsr_yn='Y' AS "mobileVisible"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys.menu ORDER BY sort_seq,menu_id

INSERT INTO sys.menu(menu_nm,scrn_id,upr_menu_id,icon_nm,sort_seq,use_yn,mbl_expsr_yn,created_by) VALUES(#{name},#{screenId},#{parentId},#{icon},#{sortOrder},#{useYn},CASE WHEN #{mobileVisible} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{actor}) RETURNING menu_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.menu SET menu_nm=#{name},upr_menu_id=#{parentId},icon_nm=#{icon},sort_seq=#{sortOrder},use_yn=#{useYn},mbl_expsr_yn=CASE WHEN #{mobileVisible} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT h.acs_hist_id AS "id",h.user_id AS "userId",h.lgn_id AS "loginId",h.acs_ty_cd AS "type",h.scrn_id AS "screenId",h.obj_desc AS "target",COALESCE(h.result_cd,'UNKNOWN') AS "result",h.ip_addr AS "ip",h.created_at AS "createdAt" FROM sys.acs_hist h ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.acs_hist_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')

SELECT DISTINCT ON (oprt_std_id) replace(oprt_std_id,'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_','') AS "type",txt_val='Y' AS "emailEnabled" FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id LIKE 'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_%' AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.oprt_std(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,txt_val,created_by) VALUES('NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_' || #{type},#{month},#{type},CASE WHEN #{emailEnabled} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET txt_val=EXCLUDED.txt_val
